designNotes: Added on 28 November 2026. Placed at the rapids (checklist code D, tributaries; the spot stands for codes D and G). designNotes: Added on 28 November 2026. Placed in the deep hole under the falls (checklist code D; the rapids spot stands for D, not a recorded G).
